name: UI-Act model
notes: The demo model has 1.8M parameters and was trained from scratch by behavioural cloning to compute simple additions and subtractions of up to two-digit numbers in an open GNOME Calculator window on Ubuntu at 1920x1080; the README says it is brittle to new backgrounds, resolutions or other windows. In the demo runner each step grabs the full screen with PIL ImageGrab, resizes it to the configured 1024x576 input, and clicks the predicted position with pyautogui until the model predicts end. Neither the trained checkpoint (run.py expects data/gnome_calculator_model/epoch=14-step=1875.ckpt) nor the demonstration recordings (the data module reads screen.mp4 and events.jsonl under data/screen_recordings/) are in the repository; the README instead offers a VirtualBox VM image, whose HTTP HEAD response on 2026-10-18 reported 23,411,565,568 bytes, last modified 2023-10-11. The README's demo-video URL uses the path TobiasNorlund/UI-Act, a name that the GitHub API now resolves to a different repository (ID 993359793; this one is 702482392). There is no LICENSE file and the GitHub API reports no license. Nothing was run.
summary: 2023 GUI agent model: a text-conditioned encoder-decoder Transformer that reads full-screen captures through a convolutional encoder and predicts left clicks on a 4-pixel grid, demonstrated on GNOME Calculator.
